heading: The weekend, day by day
intro: A little structure, plenty of mountain time. Here is the general plan for the weekend; details may change as plans come together.

days.title: Hello, Montana
days.summary: Land, stock up, and settle into mountain life.

activities.title: Arrive in Bozeman
activities.description: Pick up rental cars and collect bags as flights arrive.

activities.title: Pick up gear and supplies
activities.description: Pick up rental gear and help with groceries and other arrival-day errands.

activities.title: Pizza at the house
activities.description: Head to the Yellowstone Club house for pizza and an easy evening together.

days.title: First tracks
days.summary: Ski Yellowstone Club, then gather for hot tub happy hour, dinner at Baba, and drinks at The Boot Room.

activities.title: Ski at Yellowstone Club
activities.description: Spend the day skiing at YC. Friday is the suggested day for anyone interested in an optional lesson.

activities.title: Après-ski hot tub happy hour
activities.description: Head back to the house after skiing for the hot tub, a mule bar, glühwein, and snacks.

activities.title: Dinner at Baba
activities.description: Booked at the YC base in Warren Miller Lodge, with one table for 8 and one for 7. Seating time 7pm.

activities.title: Drinks at The Boot Room
activities.description: After dinner, plan to head to The Boot Room (bar) in Warren Miller Lodge.

days.title: Mountain time
days.summary: Ski Yellowstone Club, then head to Église and curling.

activities.title: Ski at Yellowstone Club
activities.description: Spend the day skiing at YC.

activities.title: Optional morning backcountry outing
activities.description: Join the backcountry group if the outing goes ahead.

activities.title: Lunch on the mountain
activities.description: Plan to stop at the on-mountain pizza hut for lunch.

activities.title: Après All Day at Église
activities.description: Aim to arrive around 2–3 p.m.

activities.title: Après-ski curling
activities.description: Booked from 5–7 p.m.

activities.title: Dinner at the house
activities.description: Plan to head back to the house for dinner after curling.

days.title: Birthday in the mountains
days.summary: Ski Big Sky Resort and celebrate with a birthday lunch on the mountain.

activities.title: Ski at Big Sky Resort
activities.description: Start the day on the slopes at Big Sky.

activities.title: Birthday lunch on the mountain
activities.description: Restaurant TBD.

activities.title: More skiing or hot tub time
activities.description: Keep skiing after lunch or head back to the house for the hot tub.

activities.title: Golden-hour photos
activities.description: Gather at the house for group photos.

activities.title: Birthday steak dinner
activities.description: Celebrate together over steak dinner at the house.

days.title: One last coffee
days.summary: A slow morning before the journey home.

activities.title: Breakfast and pack up
activities.description: Have breakfast at the house and pack up for departure.

activities.title: Drive to Bozeman and return rentals
activities.description: Coordinate rides around flight times and return rental gear and cars.

activities.title: Flights home :(
activities.description: Head to the airport for your flight.
